metadata.description: Local marketplace for the deck-build plugin

plugins.name: deck-build
plugins.description: Consultancy-grade .pptx generation from a reference deck. Inherits theme/colors/fonts/layout vocabulary; codifies 7 design archetypes (stage-flow, two-col-overview, spotlight-comparison, tiered-region-coverage, recommendation-hero, before-after-process, risk-heatmap) with anatomy/color/typography/icon recipes. Two-tone action title pattern + verb/word-count/weasel-word linter. Footer-clearance budget enforcement. Vision-LLM defect scan with archetype-aware prompt template. Delegates file-level pptx ops to document-skills:pptx.
